name: auth0-management
title: Auth0 Management API
summary: Auth0 Management API v2 users, users-by-email, roles and role assignment behind a client-credentials /oauth/token, with Auth0's operation ids and error shape, and rate-limit, user-exists, not-found and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Auth0 serves its Management API description per tenant (/api/v2/api-docs, Swagger 1.2) and a beta OpenAPI 3.0 download, neither under an open license or at a stable public URL, so nothing is pinned. The embedded subset keeps the Management API's operation ids (get_users, post_users, get_users_by_id, patch_users_by_id, delete_users_by_id, get_users-by-email, get_roles, get_user_roles, post_user_roles); oauth_token, for the Authentication API's token call, is named by this example.
